screens.S_ENTRY: Outside the app: launcher, a .db file opened from another app/adb, a widget tap, an alarm, boot, the share-from-another-app flow, or the test harness
screens.S_PERM_STORAGE: AnyMemo activity showing (or having just shown) the WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE runtime permission dialog (API <= 29)
screens.S_MAIN_RECENT: AnyMemo shell: Recent tab (bottom navigation) selected; recent deck list, drawer, FAB to import
screens.S_MAIN_OPEN: AnyMemo shell: Open tab selected; file browser rooted at the AnyMemo folder, create-db FAB
screens.S_MAIN_DOWNLOAD: AnyMemo shell: Download tab selected; AnyMemo-server / Dropbox source buttons
screens.S_MAIN_MISC: AnyMemo shell: Misc tab selected; options, import/export, merge, reset, donate, help, about
screens.S_DRAWER: Navigation drawer open over the AnyMemo shell
screens.S_DLG_OPEN_ACTIONS: OpenActionsFragment: Study / Edit / List / Quiz / Settings / Statistics / Share / Card player / Delete for the tapped deck
screens.S_DLG_FIRST_RUN: The first-time-run / what's-new dialog (shown once per install / upgrade)
screens.S_DLG_SDCARD_WARNING: The "sdcard not available" warning dialog (exit only)
screens.S_FILEBROWSER: FileBrowserActivity: a standalone file browser used by CardEditor (image/audio pick), DatabaseMerger, ShareScreen
screens.S_DLG_TYPEFACE_Q: FileBrowserFragment dialog (.ttf) opened from the Settings question-typeface field (SettingsScreen.java:712-721)
screens.S_DLG_TYPEFACE_A: FileBrowserFragment dialog (.ttf) opened from the Settings answer-typeface field (SettingsScreen.java:723-732)
screens.S_DLG_CREATE_DB: Create-new-database name dialog (file browser FAB / menu)
screens.S_DLG_OVERWRITE_DB: Confirm overwrite of an existing .db on import
screens.S_DLG_FB_EDIT: Long-press popup on a file-browser row: Delete / Clone / Rename
screens.S_STUDY: StudyActivity: classic study screen for the open deck
screens.S_QUIZ: QuizActivity: quiz-mode study screen (no grading persisted except via the normal grade buttons)
screens.S_CARD_PLAYER: CardPlayerActivity: hands-free audio playback of question/answer with play/prev/next/shuffle/repeat
screens.S_DLG_QUIZ_LAUNCHER: QuizLauncherDialogFragment: choose quiz by group / category / range, shuffle
screens.S_DLG_CATEGORY_STUDY: CategoryEditorFragment shown from Study (menu_memo_category): pick a category; the result goes to Study only
screens.S_DLG_CATEGORY_PREVIEW: CategoryEditorFragment shown from Preview/Edit (menu_edit_categories): pick a category; the result goes to Preview/Edit only
screens.S_DLG_CATEGORY_QUIZ: CategoryEditorFragment shown from the Quiz launcher: pick a category; the result goes to the launcher only
screens.S_DLG_CATEGORY_CARD: CategoryEditorFragment shown from CardEditor (category button): pick a category; the result goes to the editor only
screens.S_DLG_GESTURE: GestureSelectionDialogFragment: enable gestures and show which gesture does what
screens.S_DLG_NO_ITEM: The "no card to study" dialog (an empty deck or filter)
screens.S_DLG_DELETE_DECK: Confirm delete of a whole deck file (Open tab deck menu)
screens.S_DLG_WIPE_LEARNING: Confirm wipe all learning data (Preview-edit menu)
screens.S_CARD_EDITOR: CardEditor: add/edit one card (question/answer/note/category, inline image/audio)
screens.S_DLG_EDIT_DISCARD: Confirm discarding unsaved edits in CardEditor (Back with changes)
screens.S_DLG_AUDIO_RECORDER: AudioRecorderFragment: record / play / save an audio clip for a field
screens.S_DLG_AUDIO_OVERRIDE: Confirm overriding an existing audio tag in CardEditor
screens.S_CARD_LIST: CardListActivity: scrollable list of all cards with search, sort, per-row popup menus
screens.S_CARD_LIST_ROW_MENU: Single-tap popup on a card-list row: mark as learned/forgotten/new/learned-forever
screens.S_CARD_LIST_ROW_LONGMENU: Long-press popup on a card-list row: Edit / Detail / Preview-edit
screens.S_PREVIEW_EDIT: PreviewEditActivity: browse cards one at a time with New/Edit/Prev/Next and a long context menu
screens.S_DETAIL: DetailScreen: raw field editor (id, question, answer, note, category text, learning-data numbers)
screens.S_DLG_DETAIL_SAVE: Confirm saving the raw DetailScreen fields
screens.S_SETTINGS: SettingsScreen: per-deck display settings (fonts, colors, locale/audio, HTML fields)
screens.S_DLG_SETTINGS_DISCARD: Confirm discarding unsaved SettingsScreen changes (Back with changes)
screens.S_DLG_FIELD_CHOOSER: Multi-choice field-selection dialog (HTML display / field1 / field2)
screens.S_DLG_ALGORITHM_WARN: Confirm opening/resetting the scheduling-algorithm customization screen
screens.S_STATISTICS: StatisticsScreen: drawer of 4 charts (cards scheduled / accumulative / new learned / grade pie)
screens.S_DB_MERGER: DatabaseMerger: pick target + source .db and merge
screens.S_DLG_EXPORT_ANYMEMO: ExportAnyMemoDbFragment: pick a .db to export (file browser dialog, then the system Save dialog)
screens.S_DLG_CONVERTER: ConverterFragment: pick a .db to export to a foreign format (file browser dialog, then the system Save dialog for text formats)
screens.S_DLG_CONVERT_MERGE: Confirm merge-or-replace when the converted output file already exists
screens.S_DLG_DONATE: The donate dialog (Misc tab, non-pro flavor)
screens.S_DLG_DOWNLOAD_CONFIRM_AM: Confirm downloading one AnyMemo database (AnyMemo source)
screens.S_DLG_DOWNLOAD_CONFIRM_DBX: Confirm downloading one Dropbox database (Dropbox source)
screens.S_DROPBOX_LOGIN: Oauth2AccountActivity (Dropbox): an external browser/Custom Tab shows the Dropbox login page
screens.S_DROPBOX_LIST: DropboxListActivity + DropboxListFragment: browse the AnyMemo folder on Dropbox
screens.S_DROPBOX_UPLOAD: UploadDropboxActivity: pick a local .db to upload to Dropbox
screens.S_DLG_DROPBOX_UPLOAD_CONFIRM: Confirm uploading the picked file to Dropbox
screens.S_EXT_PICKER: The system document picker / Save dialog (another package)
screens.S_EXT_BROWSER: An external browser / Custom Tab (another package)
screens.S_HOME_WIDGET: Launcher home screen with an AnyMemo widget showing the recent decks
screens.S_NOTIF_REVIEW: Notification shade with the "cards to review" reminder notification
screens.S_SHARE_SCREEN: ShareScreen: add a card received from another app's share/ACTION_SEND
screens.S_EXIT: The process ended (finish() back out of the task, or System.exit on a forced version reset)
